config.title: Skillfiles
config.registryPath: Path to the skill registry root
config.sharedSkillRoot: Path to shared skills root (scans ~/.agent, ~/.gemini, etc.)
config.scanRoots: List of scan roots with key-path pairs
config.scanRoots.key: Unique key for this scan root
config.scanLimit: Maximum number of repositories to scan
config.autoPushOnSave: Automatically push changes when skill.md is saved
config.conflictPolicy: Policy for handling conflicts during collect
config.auditLogRetentionDays: Number of days to retain audit logs
config.historyRetentionCount: Number of history snapshots to retain per skill
config.agentProfiles: Agent-specific file path configurations. Each agent can have instructionPaths (for reference), skillFolderPath, and skillFileName.
config.agentProfiles.instructionPaths: Instruction file paths (not managed by Skillfiles)
config.agentProfiles.skillFolderPath: Folder path where skills are deployed
